description: Read whether a transaction is pending, successful, failed, or not found on QIE mainnet (chain 1990) or testnet (chain 1983). The result includes the block number, confirmations, from, to, value, token transfers when the explorer reports them, and an explorer link. Example QIE ID: yourname.qie. This does not submit a transaction. This tool does not give price, APY, returns, yield, or investment advice and will decline such questions.

network.description: Pinned network. mainnet is chain 1990 and testnet is chain 1983. Defaults to mainnet. A raw chain ID or RPC URL is not accepted.

txHash.description: Transaction hash: 0x followed by 64 hex characters.

name: qie_get_tx_status
title: Get transaction status
